description: Lakhs of devotees witness Lord Jagannath Bahuda Yatra
body_lead: Lakhs of devotees witness Lord Jagannath Bahuda Yatra Bhubaneswar: The Odisha Police has started making extensive use of technology to provide better policing services, information, security and surveillance during the ongoing Rath Yatra festival of Lord Jagannath. After putting the 'Jaga Drone' to use, the Odisha Police has now introduced WhatsApp chatbot to provide real-time information regarding traffic space and route planning for the first time during Bahuda Yatra on Monday.
